body:
I harvested fresh Klip Dagga leaves in the morning and dried them. The leaves were ground down then rubbed on a screen. The kief was then collected and smoked.
First hit: surprisingly smooth, didn't even cough. I felt light headed instantly, but it wasn't uncomfortable, it was very smooth.
Second hit: nothing different effects stayed same
Third hit: same, last hit
After: light headedness continued, and muscle relaxing effects kicked in. I would compare the experience to a bowl of low grade cannabis. Will definitely try again with more kief and a water pipe. This would make a good natural cannabis alternative LetJahBePraised
